definition: Moving-average type-token ratio: the share of different words in each 100-word window of a page, averaged over every window.
raw: Weird, for us, means varied words. We slide a window of 100 words along each page one word at a time, count the different words in each window and average them: the moving-average type-token ratio, MATTR. The fixed window lets the shortest page, 193 words, meet the longest, 14,037 words, since the share of different words in a whole page falls as the page grows.
